Lol -_-   Getting requirements to build wheel ... error
  error: subprocess-exited-with-error
  
  × Getting requirements to build wheel did not run successfully.
  │ exit code: 1
  ╰─> [10 lines of output]
      
      
      **********************************************************************
      ERROR! Cannot compile nvdiffrast CUDA extension. Please ensure that:
      
      1. You have PyTorch installed
      2. You run 'pip install' with --no-build-isolation flag
      **********************************************************************
      
      
      [end of output]
  
  note: This error originates from a subprocess, and is likely not a problem with pip.
ERROR: Failed to build 'git+https://github.com/NVlabs/nvdiffrast' when getting requirements to build wheel
siah@busiah ~/creative/reactjit $
resolution: InstantMesh setup hit nvdiffrast build error ('Cannot compile nvdiffrast CUDA extension ... run pip install with --no-build-isolation'). Cause: nvdiffrast's build imports torch but pip build-isolation hides it. Steps 1-4 of the script (clone, conda py3.10 env, torch cu124, deps) succeeded; only the nvdiffrast step failed. Gave the user the immediate one-liner (conda activate instantmesh && pip install --no-build-isolation git+.../nvdiffrast) and fixed setup-instantmesh.sh to add --no-build-isolation. Committed.
